s14.query: Co zabezpieczyć przed aktualizacją firmware Atlas i jakie dwa wyniki muszą znaleźć się w odbiorze?

evidence.passage: Before updating Atlas firmware, disconnect the excitation output and verify that the recovery image can be restored.
evidence.text:
## Prerequisites
Before updating Atlas firmware, disconnect the excitation output and verify that the recovery image can be restored. Keep the instrument powered from the approved isolated supply while copying its configuration. A screenshot of the live display is insufficient because it omits calibration and trigger state. Export the complete configuration bundle and record its checksum before opening the maintenance session.

evidence.passage: the timestamp drift remains below 80 microseconds over the complete test interval.
evidence.text:
## Acceptance
Atlas passes acceptance only when the timestamp drift remains below 80 microseconds over the complete test interval. The acceptance record must also contain a continuous 40-second trace without a dropped sample. Inspect the exported file, not only the live display. A short successful capture does not establish compliance with the complete interval requirement.

# PostgreSQL transaction review
## Read committed
Read Committed obtains a new snapshot for each statement.
Two reads in one transaction can therefore observe different committed data.

# SQLite WAL engineering note
## Concurrency
WAL lets readers overlap a writer, but there is still only one writer at a time.
All database processes must share a host; WAL is unsuitable for a network filesystem.
Each read transaction retains its original committed snapshot until it ends.
